mining.name: Mining
mining.desc: Reading stone: where a vein runs, where it's rich, where it's about to give. Higher skill means more ore per vein and, in time, the rarer things stone hides.

herbalism.name: Herbalism
herbalism.desc: Knowing a plant by its leaf, its smell and what it drinks. Higher skill means more from every plant -- and knowing which ones are worth the trouble.

fishing.name: Fishing
fishing.desc: Patience, mostly. Still water hides more than fish.

hunting.name: Hunting
hunting.desc: Tracking, waiting, and a clean kill. What a creature leaves behind is worth more in skilled hands.

smithing.name: Smithing
smithing.desc: Ore, heat and patience into weapons and armor. Skill raises the chance of success and of a finer piece.

alchemy.name: Alchemy
alchemy.desc: Pills and elixirs: refining what plants and monsters hold into qi you can swallow.

medicine.name: Medicine
medicine.desc: Salves, poultices and the knowledge of what a body needs. Healers are welcome everywhere.

jewelcrafting.name: Jewelcrafting
jewelcrafting.desc: Setting stones and shaping precious metal into things that hold qi. Rare work, rare materials.

sword.name: Swordplay
sword.desc: The straight blade: cut, guard, thrust. Untrained hands swing it like a stick.

dagger.name: Knife-work
dagger.desc: Close, quick, and quiet. A dagger in a novice's hand is mostly a way to get cut.

saber.name: Saber
saber.desc: The curved blade that wants to keep moving.

spear.name: Spear
spear.desc: Distance is the whole art. Lose it and the spear is a long stick.

axe.name: Axe
axe.desc: Weight and commitment. Miss and you're open.

hammer.name: Hammer
hammer.desc: Slow, crushing, and tiring -- until your body learns where the weight wants to go.

halberd.name: Polearm
halberd.desc: Halberds and glaives: reach and weight together, and the hardest to learn.

staff.name: Staff
staff.desc: The oldest weapon, and the one qi flows through most easily.

unarmed.name: Unarmed
unarmed.desc: Fists, elbows, knees, and fist wraps. Everyone starts here -- everyone who lives has some.

survival.name: Survival
survival.desc: Staying alive where the world doesn't care if you do: spotting a trap's tell, dressing a wound in the field, getting more from a kill, knowing when to rest. Higher skill means traps bite less, healing goes further, your wounds close on their own between fights, and hunts give more.

taming.name: Taming
taming.desc: Patience with animals: feeding, calming, teaching. A tamer's familiar grows into something more, and the tamer learns to ask more of it (the taming tree, at your familiar's side).

warden.name: Path of the Warden
warden.description: Defensive focus, tailored for steady progression.

seeker.name: Path of the Seeker
seeker.description: Exploration focus, tailored for active players.

bow.name: Archery
bow.desc: Draw, aim, loose. Distance is the whole art -- and so is not getting caught.

crossbow.name: Crossbow
crossbow.desc: A machine's patience in your hands: slow to ready, certain to land.

ki.name: Ki Projection
ki.desc: Qi sent out of the palm. The cultivator's oldest long-range art.
